title: Knowledge Article Generation and Management
markdown:
For AI agents: the docs index is at https://docs.leena.ai/llms.txt. Append .md to any documentation page URL to get its markdown version.

#### Knowledge Creation   [Skip link to Knowledge Creation](https://docs.leena.ai/docs/knowledge-article-generation-and-management\#knowledge-creation)

Helpdesk Insights can generate generates knowledge articles, with a click of a button, based on the insights gained from clustered tickets.

#### Focus on Common Issues   [Skip link to Focus on Common Issues](https://docs.leena.ai/docs/knowledge-article-generation-and-management\#focus-on-common-issues)

Knowledge articles prioritise the most frequent agent responses and repetitive procedures, providing users with the actionable information they need to resolve issues independently.

#### Incremental Updates   [Skip link to Incremental Updates](https://docs.leena.ai/docs/knowledge-article-generation-and-management\#incremental-updates)

The system can prompt the user to regenerate knowledge articles when significant changes within a cluster, ensuring the articles stay up-to-date with new content.

#### KM Integration   [Skip link to KM Integration](https://docs.leena.ai/docs/knowledge-article-generation-and-management\#km-integration)

Knowledge articles are effortlessly saved directly into the existing Knowledge Management System (KM), ensuring easy access, management and discoverability.

#### Benefit   [Skip link to Benefit](https://docs.leena.ai/docs/knowledge-article-generation-and-management\#benefit)

Improved self-service rates with readily available and accurate knowledge articles highlighting common user issues.
